# Scroll area

A region with its own styled scrollbars.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** A fixed-height panel inside a page, such as the phone menu in a sheet. Not the article: let the page scroll.

- **Use it when:** A fixed-height list or panel inside a larger page.
- **Not when:** The whole page: let the page scroll.

Instead:

- [Message scroller](./message-scroller.md): A conversation that keeps the newest in view.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | The region can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add scroll-area
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Scroll area reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Scroll area has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
